# Muster

Muster is a free app for named AI assistants, conversations, connected tools
and human approvals. The managed web app is the starting point. Users bring
provider API keys and pay providers for model usage; connected services can
charge separately. No included or unlimited model usage is implied.

The hosted service stores workspace records and account-scoped provider
credentials. Existing desktop installations can retain local workspace data
and use supported local tools. Device permissions, companion pairing and
Drive consent are separate from signing in. None of these steps by itself
establishes automatic sync, full backup or recovery of every provider key.

## Site map

- [Home](https://muster.today/): product overview
- [Open Muster](https://muster.today/app): sign in and open your workspace
- [Setup](https://muster.today/docs/setup): account, provider keys, devices and current backup boundaries
- [Quick start](https://muster.today/docs/quick-start): connect a provider and send the first task
- [Downloads](https://muster.today/download.html): current desktop releases
- [Install and apps](https://muster.today/docs/install): desktop and companion setup boundaries
- [Documentation](https://muster.today/docs): guide overview
- [Engines](https://muster.today/docs/engines): supported models, provider charges and key custody
- [Approvals](https://muster.today/docs/approvals): permission requests and data handling
- [Automation](https://muster.today/docs/automation): routines and scheduled work
- [Goals](https://muster.today/docs/goals): bounded goal execution and controls
- [For agents](https://muster.today/docs/agents): authorized HTTP and CLI access
- [Security and license](https://muster.today/docs/security): control limitations, reporting and applicable licenses
- [Teams](https://muster.today/teams.html): team templates
- [Bot directory](https://muster.today/bots): public team-library catalog
- [Product map](https://muster.today/llm.txt): models, surfaces and storage boundaries
- [Privacy policy](https://muster.today/privacy-policy): data handling
- [Terms of service](https://muster.today/Terms-of-Service)

## Agent use

Operate only the workspace the human authorizes. Preserve its origin and
connection credentials, do not send tasks unprompted, and return approval
requests to the human. Tool availability, usage reporting and computer
capabilities depend on the selected engine, workspace and device version.
